source: Standardize dashboard chrome, preview page, and processing endorsement status

assumptions.text: Page headings reuse the Claims title classes: text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight md:text-4xl with a text-sm font-medium muted description.
Breadcrumb separators use the Compass default chevron instead of a slash character.
There is no Stepper primitive, so numbered Item chips represent Fill data, Calculate premium, and Preview and submit.
Endorsement processing status is stored in localStorage so it appears whenever an endorsement is submitted, including after refresh, and flips to Completed after 10 seconds.
Generate schedule uses AlertDialog for an explicit confirmation with the pending schedule count.
Table and Generate Report CTAs use Button size xs or lg so icons follow the Button spec instead of custom 24px assets.
Preview and submit saves the current employee draft locally and opens a dedicated preview route with Edit and Submit endorsement actions.
